scope: Authoritative continuous execution, quote preview and observed best-quote flow

backend.includes: SQL.js transactions, injected write failure, exact notional, FOK, iceberg priority, concurrent idempotency, liquidation residuals

go.includes: Finite-preview quantity/notional/fee and cent-unit HTTP contract

timezoneFixtures.reason: Legacy fixtures now state +08:00 for exchange-session instants instead of inheriting the host timezone.

limits: The production generator remains a hybrid of exogenous market factors and order-book execution prices.
Synthetic depth is finite between refreshes but does not form a closed cash/share-conserving population.
Production event OFI includes synthetic quote replacement and samples sweeps at committed endpoints; it is not real Level 2 or informed-trading attribution.
The database transaction boundary covers continuous real-account submissions and pending orders, not every auction, forced-liquidation or AI-initiated workflow.
No real-player trade or live login was performed by the validation; browser account flows used a local synthetic upstream.
No claim of long-run profitability, calibrated resilience, optimal execution or improved real-market prediction is made.
